Weak design, not a veto: the gain is credited only when a run beats the current best, so most rewards are 0. When both arms' average gains are equal (for example, both 0), np.argmax picks arm 0, which biases the bandit toward fresh random restarts. The old schedule moved to perturbing the best packing after 30% of the time, so this may explain the drop.
